lede: Security-Widefield's Christmas centers on Widefield Parks & Recreation on Aspen Drive, where the department holds its annual tree lighting with Santa, carolers, s'mores and free youth activities.
celebrates: Security-Widefield's holiday season centers on Widefield Parks & Recreation, which holds its 21st annual holiday celebration on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, with free youth activities, s'mores, cookies, hot cocoa, carolers, Santa and a craft fair, and collects new toys at its Recreation Center through the tree lighting. The department also runs a 12 Days of Fitmas challenge from December 1 to 24 with an ornament prize and an Elf on the Shelf game in its fitness area. Families also head into nearby Colorado Springs for bigger shows.

facts: Widefield Parks & Recreation is at 755 Aspen Drive in Colorado Springs, CO 80911, and its Recreation Center there is where new toys are collected for the tree lighting. The 12 Days of Fitmas challenge asks kids and adults to finish fitness challenges between December 1 and 24 for a 2026 WPR Fitness ornament and a chance at a $100 Scheels gift card. Challenge sheets are available at Guest Services starting November 23.
trains: The sources we checked show no train stop in Security-Widefield, and Amtrak does not serve Colorado Springs.
